## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull-request description should document verification as required by project policy. Digit preservation also lacks test coverage.

## Changes
The pull request adds a title-to-slug helper and parameterized tests covering case conversion, separator normalization, and empty results. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- PR body — correctness — Add the required Testing section — The supplied description omits the required verification section. `AGENTS.md:4` states: “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers cannot obtain the required verification record from the pull-request description.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Test digit preservation in numeric titles — For `Release 2026`, a regression that removes digits would pass the current tests: none exercises the `0-9` alternative in the changed character class. — Numeric portions of page URLs lack regression protection. — Fix: Extend `test_slugify` with a title containing digits.
